printed: Street (name scribbled over / illegible, only 'ST.' readable)
note: Side street runs ENE from Beekman to the Cummings strip along the west side of the railroad tracks; T at its east end. Cummings right-of-way merges with the track corridor here, so its centreline x is uncertain (~8320-8380).

printed: Street (CARLL printed further west on the plate; 'STREET' in region)
note: Carll runs east and ends at the 40-ft Cummings strip (NNW-SSE, beside the railroad, with 12in sewer and 10in water pipe). Area just north is off-plate (white).
Narrow 40-ft N-S street printed 'SEDLEY ST.' runs south from Knox; T on Knox's south side.

printed: Casper (30-ft N-S strip; CASPER printed further north, Trade Street continues it SW below y 2170)
note: The NE-running street (today Saint Leo Place, also the street meeting Baltimore at job 33_004) begins at its SW end on the Casper strip just above where Casper bends SW into Trade Street. Pink/grey boundary bands run along both sides of Casper.
50-ft street with 4in W. pipe and 12in sewer runs NE from Casper and ends on the south side of Baltimore (E-W part, street-railway line along its south edge).
Plate's Sperber St (30 ft, slanting NNE) ends at Queen City. Queen City's south edge is cut off by the plate's bottom edge (~y 5828 here); y estimated from north edge ~5772 plus half a normal width.
Sperber continues north of Montrose slightly offset east (labelled only 'ST.'); Montrose carries 12in sewer and 4in W.P. here. Today's Ekardt = plate Sperber.

Everglade is a short E-W court (~x 3150-3610, y ~4928) about 180 px north of Harrison; it does not reach Harrison. Its west end abuts lot 245 and lots 221/222, east end joins a 50-ft N-S street at x ~3635 that turns east, not to Harrison. At the expected point only lot lines meet Harrison's north side.

Plate street at y ~5370 (west) rising east past a small triangular island merges into Harrison where Harrison flattens to E-W; Y-shaped merge spread over x ~5750-5950. TREMONT is the separate street at y ~4960.
Plate Biestler (south leg, centre x ~990) and a 30-ft street north of Montrose (centre x ~1028) form a slight jog at Montrose. Today's Sperber Avenue = plate Biestler.
Narrow N-S street with 18in sewer runs south from Carll toward Beekman's diagonal (BEEKMAN printed near 7700,1850); a short stub continues north of Carll to the plate edge (white just above y ~1000).

printed: Street (no name printed here; HORTON printed east of White Street)
note: Richter Ave runs south along the plate's west edge from the E-W street with 6in W. pipe; crossing is cut by the west plate edge, west half of Richter off-plate.
